Package index

Blinding data

The two functions that do the work. blind_file() is blind_data() with a reader and a writer around it.

blind_file()
Blind a data file
blind_data()
Blind a data frame
format(<blind_summary>) print(<blind_summary>)
The summary of a blinded table

Other ways to run it

A local app in the browser, and a command for the terminal.

run_app()
Blind a data file in a browser
install_cli()
Install the datablinder command

The package

datablinder datablinder-package
datablinder: Synthetic Look-Alike Copies of Sensitive Data Files
